object_description: A discriminator between failure of the current ARN extraction/mapping family and failure of the parent abstraction that usable prose-level relational structure exists for the registered downstream analogy decision.
qoi: Whether supplying independently grounded relational structure while holding the downstream evaluator fixed materially restores the registered decision, thereby localizing responsibility below the parent abstraction rather than licensing ascent by repeated raw failure.
scope: fresh or quarantined-from-design externally grounded mapping cases
assumptions: the downstream evaluator and gate remain fixed across local-extractor and supplied-structure arms
supplied structure is independently grounded and candidate-invisible
existing ARN v1-v5 negatives remain immutable development history
no ascent is licensed from repeated local failures without this discriminator

strongest_parents.justification: Strongest executed local family: multiple learned/structured variants were admissible yet ended NEGATIVE__CAPABILITY_ABSENT.
The local-vs-parent question requires an arm where relational structure is supplied independently rather than extracted by the failed local family.
A strong semantic/structure-abduction parent prevents an oracle-only contrast from being mistaken for evidence that the RAKL representation is uniquely needed.

prior_art_equivalence_map: causal intervention on representation while holding evaluator fixed
oracle_or_lower_bound: The independently supplied gold/human mapping arm is an upper-bound diagnostic for extraction responsibility: if the fixed downstream decision still cannot clear its registered gates with correct structure supplied, more local extractor search cannot by itself close the parent abstraction. It is never a fair performance parent.
minimal_counterexamples: local extractor fails but supplied human structure passes: do not ascend; extraction remains responsible
local extractor and supplied structure both fail: parent abstraction/evaluator/question remains challenged
local extractor passes on fresh cases: repeated historical failure does not justify ascent
oracle structure passes only because evaluator sees answer-bearing annotations
structure-abduction parent matches supplied-structure arm at lower cost
falsifier: The independently supplied-structure arm fails to separate the parent abstraction from the strongest local extractor, or the result depends on evaluator/gold leakage rather than the representation intervention.
same_system_ablation: Hold case bytes, downstream evaluator, threshold, and resource accounting fixed; replace only the local extraction/mapping stage with independently supplied grounded structure.
hard_gate_obligations: same downstream evaluator epoch across arms
local and parent arms have explicit cost accounting
no ASCEND unless AncestorChallenge packet is complete
total_cost_equation: arm_total = acquisition/materialization + extraction_or_supplied_structure + mapping + downstream_decision + verification
novelty_residual: A parent-discriminating intervention that fills the exact missing `local_vs_parent_discriminator_id` field of the ARN AncestorChallenge instead of treating repeated failure as ascent evidence.
permitted_publication_claim: At most: on the frozen discriminator cases, responsibility localized to local extraction, parent abstraction/evaluator, or remained CANNOT_CHECK. The discriminator alone does not establish analogy utility or scientific authority.
